summary: Implements S03-R2 of SPEC-03. Parsers for the profile, ranking and battle history reads will be built on owner-supplied captures, so a capture that still holds a token, e-mail or user id must fail CI before it can land.  tests/test_profile_reads.py scans every file under tests/fixtures/live_sanitized/ recursively and fails on any value that a sdk/redaction.py pattern would redact (an exact redaction marker is allowed, since it redacts to itself), a number in a field named Id or ending in UserId (XML attribute or element, JSON key, query parameter, with or without @), an e-mail address, and token-like strings (UUIDs, 32+ hex, non-empty values in token/secret/password/checksum/devicekey fields). Findings name the file, line and kind, never the value. Planted secrets in temporary trees prove each class is detected and that clean sanitized files pass; the real directory passes.  tests/fixtures/live_sanitized/README.md tells the owner how to sanitize and record a capture (date, game version, steps applied, reviewer) and what must never appear. No parsers are added; they need the captures (S03-R1). Implemented by the SPEC-03 builder specialist subagent in an isolated worktree, independently reviewed by the verifier subagent (tests cite its requirement ids; parent re-validated in a scratch clone), and re-validated by the parent.
